subject: Next steps: security qualification, PT report request & vuln SLAs
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlascorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for the demo — security follow-up & PT request

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Per our conversation I wanted to summarize the security qualification items you asked about and propose immediate next steps so your InfoSec team can pick this up. Short version up front: we are SOC 2 Type II in scope, we have a standard vendor questionnaire pack, and we can provide a redacted pen-test summary plus a proposed vulnerability-disclosure SLA for review.

What I'll do next (proposed):
- Share the redacted pen-test summary and our typical vulnerability-disclosure SLA (attachment).
- Open a dedicated security intake thread with our security ops (copied) to answer the vendor questionnaire you mentioned.
- If you want a fresh pen-test report (full unredacted) we can start the formal request and provide timeline and scoping requirements — estimated 4–6 weeks for onboarding depending on NDA and access.

Questions from your side I captured during the call:
1) SOC 2 status & date of last audit
2) Data residency & GDPR controls for EU customers
3) Whether we sign standard vulnerability-disclosure SLAs and expected remediation SLAs (30/60/90-day tiers)
4) Process to receive full pen-test reports under an NDA

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (stub), vuln-disclosure-sla-proposal-ATL.docx (stub)

If that plan looks good, I'll start by sending the attachments and looping in Neha from Security for the questionnaire intake.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlascorp.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@atlascorp.com
Date: 2027-04-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — security follow-up & PT request

Thanks Aditya —

That summary is perfect. Quick answers from my side and a couple follow-ups from InfoSec (cc'd):
- SOC 2: we require Type II; we'll need the certificate and the associated control matrix.
- Pen-test: we'll require a copy of the full report under an NDA (redactions are ok for public docs).
- SLAs: our standard expectation is a critical/urgent 7-day response, high 30-day, medium 60-day, low 90-day. Is that compatible?

InfoSec — is there a vendor questionnaire we should fill and return, or would you like us to receive your standard pack?

Appreciate the speedy turnaround. If you can share the attachments and an initial proposed SLA we can circulate internally.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering, AtlasCorp
liam.oconnor@atlascorp.com
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlascorp.com>
Cc: security@atlascorp.com
Date: 2027-04-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — security follow-up & PT request

Hi all — looping in as requested. Quick intro: I'm Neha (Security Ops lead at Redwood). I can take the vendor questionnaire and coordinate a redacted/full pen-test delivery under NDA. A few operational notes and clarifying questions to speed this:

1) SOC 2 artifacts: we can share the SOC 2 Type II report via a secure link once we have a contact and purpose-of-use confirmation. We will also provide the control matrix (CSV) and evidence samples where appropriate.

2) Pen-test: our most recent third-party assessment was completed 2026-11 and we have a redacted executive summary suitable for general distribution (attached by Aditya). For the full technical report we require a standard mutual NDA + an SP access form; timeline for full delivery is ~7 business days after NDA execution if report already produced, or 4–6 weeks if you require a fresh assessment.

3) Vulnerability SLA: we are comfortable formalizing an SLA. We typically propose tiered timelines: Critical 7 days, High 21–30 days, Medium 60 days, Low 90 days. We're happy to align with AtlasCorp's stricter 7/30/60/90 tiers on critical/high if needed — we'll note that in the proposal doc.

4) Scan cadence & monitoring: our baseline is weekly authenticated scans + continuous external monitoring. We also run quarterly external pentests and annual full-scope third-party engagements. If you want a specific cadence for shared scans (e.g., monthly authenticated scans for scoped endpoints) we can propose that in the intake.

Next steps I propose:
- Aditya: share the attachments and the HubSpot link so we can tag the intake to the deal (deal id: ATL-4782).
- Liam: confirm the NDA contact and whether AtlasCorp will use your standard vendor security questionnaire or accept Redwood's pack.
- Once NDA contact is confirmed we'll send the DocuSign NDA and, upon signature, provide the full report (if applicable) and a finalized SLA.

I've attached a draft vuln-disclosure SLA in the drive folder and included the HubSpot link for the deal.

-Neha Kapoor
Security Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlascorp.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, security@atlascorp.com
Date: 2027-04-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the demo — security follow-up & PT request

Great — thanks for the fast responses, Liam.

Per Neha's note I've uploaded the artifacts to a secure Drive folder (link below) and started a HubSpot intake (ATL-4782) so our CS/Security teams can track the ask. For immediate review I've also attached the redacted pen-test summary and an SLA proposal (see attachments).

Doc links / attachments:
- Secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cATLsec
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/4782
- Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (stub), vuln-disclosure-sla-proposal-ATL.docx (stub)

Neha will send a short intake form via DocuSign for NDA contact info and purpose-of-use; Liam — can you confirm the contact who will sign from AtlasCorp (name, title, email)? Once we have that we'll route the DocuSign and, upon signature, either: (a) deliver the existing full report if it's permitted under the NDA, or (b) schedule a fresh assessment and provide a timeline.

Proposed SLA alignment: we'll adopt AtlasCorp's 7/30/60/90 timeline for critical/high/medium/low as requested; we'll include that language in the final SLA doc for signature.

If you want, we can also schedule a 30-minute intake call with Neha tomorrow to walk the questionnaire and scoping.

Thanks,
Aditya
